title: perilepta maclellandii
intro: Perilepta maclellandii, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a type of herbaceous plant that belongs to the family Urticaceae. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and aiding in the management of diabetes. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents of Perilepta maclellandii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
